CustomField.description: Name of the listing broker, as stated in the broker email. Distinct from the forwarding broker captured on Broker_First__c / Forwarded_By_Email__c — a blast platform's sender is often not the listing broker.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populated by LLM extraction from the inbound broker email; null when not stated in the email.
CustomField.label: Listing Broker Name
